lead: A trailing `->` with a keyword on the next line is parsed as that keyword being the member name, not as recovery.
body: `$u->` followed by `if (true) {` is one `$u->if(true)` call, because a member name accepts a keyword the way PHP's does, so a case written to pin resilient behaviour ends up freezing an answer about `if` rather than about the arrow. Reach `MemberName::Missing` by leaving the arrow at end of file and putting the unclosed brace *above* it.
